{{Quote|The Wantu believe in a river that heals all wounds.|[[FR-D 8T-KA]], to [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]]|<ref name="SW108" />}}
The '''Wantu''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that hailed from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The members of this species believed in a river that could heal all wounds.

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] [[FR-D 8T-KA]] mentioned the Wantu during a conversation with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] described them as one of the various Outer Rim cultures that had legends of organics being restored.
